children: Trent Limited (NSE:TRENT) posted Q2 FY27 beats—revenue ~Rs 5,873cr, net profit ~Rs 468cr and EBITDA ~Rs 785cr—while adding 27 stores and expanding Westside/Zudio footprint; leadership changes and board additions accompany mixed broker views and a failed Tata Starbucks in‑store tie‑up.
Trent Limited Net Profit Up, Revenue Rise
: Trent (TRENT) Q2 FY27: net profit ~Rs 468 crore (+25% YoY), revenue ~Rs 5,873 crore (+22%), EBITDA ~Rs 785 crore (+37%), added 27 stores (total 1,342); stock rose ~5–7% intraday.
Trent Limited Appoints Bahram Vakil Chairman
: Trent Limited (TRENT) appoints Bahram N. Vakil as chairman effective November 12, 2026. Noel N. Tata retires as chairman November 11, 2026 and becomes Chairman Emeritus.
: Trent (TRENT) opened 10 Westside stores and added ~17–19 Zudio stores in the quarter, taking counts to 311 Westside, about 999 Zudio (incl. seven UAE) and 32 other stores as of Sept 30, 2026.
: Brokerages varied on Trent Limited (TRENT): Jefferies Hold tgt ₹3,300; HSBC Buy ₹3,480; Ambit Buy ₹3,509; Citi Sell ₹2,815, citing margin sustainability concerns despite revenue and EBITDA beats.
: TRENT appoints Rajiv Dube as additional non-exec director effective 30 Oct 2026, pending shareholder approval; Dube brings 40+ years' experience across Tata and Aditya Birla groups.
: Trent Limited (TRENT) named Kalpana Merchant additional director and proposed her as independent director from Oct 30, 2026 to Oct 29, 2029, pending shareholder approval; she has 45+ years in law.
Trent Talks With Tata Starbucks Ended
: Trent Limited (TRENT) held talks with Tata Starbucks on an in‑store coffee concept; negotiations ended over disagreements on store format, locations and Tata Starbucks' operational control.
